description: Read a background record import's status and progress, by jobId or by model (jobId wins when both are given). By model it returns the import still running or awaiting confirmation, else the model's latest import in any status. `status` goes uploading -> queued -> running -> completed, failed or cancelled, with awaitingConfirmation in between when rows are invalid and the import was started with onInvalid STOP. `phase` is validate, then write; `validated` of `total` and then `processed` are the progress, `created`/`updated`/`unchanged` what was written, `invalidCount` the rows validation refused, `failedCount` the rows refused when written. `sample` holds the first 20 invalid or failed rows with their message - page all of them with list_record_import_rows. A failed import carries `failureReason` (stalled, enqueueFailed, unexpected, modelUnavailable, invalidUpsertKey) and `resumable`: when true, resume_record_import continues it. `job` is null when the id is unknown or the model has no import on record - a finished import is kept for 7 days. Imports run in steps of a few hundred rows: check again later rather than in a tight loop.

jobId.description: The job id start_record_import returned. When given, modelIdOrSlug is ignored.

modelIdOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug: returns the import still running or awaiting confirmation on it, or - when there is none - its most recently started import in any status

name: get_record_import
